name: length_interleave
prelude:
def interleave : List α → List α → List α
  | [], ys => ys
  | x :: xs, ys => x :: interleave ys xs
termination_by xs ys => xs.length + ys.length
statement:
theorem length_interleave (xs ys : List α) :
    (interleave xs ys).length = xs.length + ys.length
proofs:
fun_induction interleave xs ys with
  | case1 ys => simp
  | case2 x xs ys ih => simp [ih]; omega
  have h : ∀ n (as bs : List α), as.length + bs.length = n →
      (interleave as bs).length = as.length + bs.length := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro as bs hn
      cases as with
      | nil => rw [interleave, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add]
      | cons a as => simp at hn
    | succ n ih =>
      intro as bs hn
      cases as with
      | nil => rw [interleave, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add]
      | cons a as =>
        rw [interleave, List.length_cons, ih bs as (by simp at hn; omega), List.length_cons]
        omega
  exact h _ xs ys rfl
